description: This file defines the WorkspaceForm class, a Drupal form controller for editing workspace entities within the workspaces_ui module. It includes methods for creating the form, handling validation, saving, and activating workspaces.

classes.name: WorkspaceForm
classes.description: A Drupal form controller class for editing workspace entities, providing form building, validation, saving, and activation functionalities.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates an instance of the form, injecting the workspace manager service.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Builds the workspace edit form with fields for label and ID.

methods.name: getEditedFieldNames
methods.description: Returns the list of field names that are being edited.

methods.name: flagViolations
methods.description: Flags validation violations for specific fields.

methods.name: actions
methods.description: Defines form actions, including a special 'Save and switch' for new workspaces.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the workspace entity, logs the operation, and redirects or rebuilds the form based on success.

methods.name: activate
methods.description: Sets the current workspace as active and displays a confirmation message.
